test_title: PYST 72: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The policy required citizens to link their ID with mobile numbers.

options.text: Citizens were required by the policy to link their ID with mobile numbers.
Citizens had to link their ID with mobile numbers.
Linking of ID to mobile numbers was required from citizens.
It was required by the policy to to mobile numbers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the active voice: "The policy required citizens to link their ID with mobile numbers."
 
• The sentence is in the **Simple Past Tense** (Subject + V2 + Object).
 
• To convert from active to passive voice in the Simple Past Tense: 
 
 
• The object "citizens" becomes the new subject. Since "citizens" is plural, we use "were."
 
• The structure for passive voice is: **Subject + was/were + past participle (V3) + by + Agent**.
 
• "Required" (V2) changes to "were required" (Passive).
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Citizens were required by the policy to link their ID with mobile numbers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Citizens had to link..." – Changes the modal meaning; "had to" expresses obligation but is not the passive form of "required."
 
• **Option 3: **"Linking of ID..." – Changes the subject to a gerund phrase, altering the original sentence structure significantly.
 
• **Option 4: **"It was required by the policy to to mobile numbers." – This sentence is grammatically incomplete and contains a repetition of "to."
